board: Wyoming Board of Certified Public Accountants

cycle.note: Wyoming certificates renew every December 31. CPE: 120 hours over the three calendar years ending this year, at least 80 technical, plus the 4-hour Wyoming ethics course once every three years.

requirements.label: Three-year total

byYearsSinceIssue.note: No CPE is due for your first renewal (Ch. 5 §5-3(c)).
Second renewal: 60 hours over the year you were certified and this year (only courses after your certificate count).

requirements.note: 120 hours in the three calendar years ending December 31 (Ch. 5 §5-3(c)).

requirements.label: Technical

byYearsSinceIssue.note: Second renewal: at least 40 of the 60 hours technical.

requirements.note: At least two-thirds (80 of 120) in technical subjects.

requirements.label: Independent study
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 12 hours of independent (self) study count per three-year period.

requirements.label: Nano-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 10 nano-learning hours count each calendar year.

requirements.label: Wyoming ethics
requirements.note: The Board-approved 4-hour Wyoming ethics course (Wyoming statutes and rules, 80% to pass) once every three years, and within 6 months of first certification. We count courses with "Wyoming" and "ethics" in the title.

newLicensee.note: First renewal: no CPE. Second renewal: 60 hours over two years. After that, 120 over three. The Wyoming ethics course is due within 6 months of certification.

licenseDateHint: Wyoming certificates renew every year on December 31.
issueDateHint: New certificate holders: nothing for the first renewal, 60 hours for the second, then 120 over three years.
limitsNotTracked: All 4 Wyoming ethics hours must be completed in the same calendar year.
A course repeated in the same year doesn't count again.
recordRetention: Keep CPE evidence for 4 years after completion.
toVerify: Independent-study limit (12) applied per three-year window; nano limit per calendar year — from the 2019 rule filing.
Second renewal window = the year certified plus the next year.
